ignore_dates.1980-01-01: Example: a household member's birthday (not a document date)

recipients.Alex: Alex Example (also: Al, A. Example, Mr. Example when context implies Alex)
recipients.Sam: Sam Example (also: Samantha Example, Mrs. Example, Ms. Example)
recipients.Household: Both Alex and Sam, "The Example Family", or the household generally
recipients.Unknown: Anyone else, or the recipient cannot be determined from the document

topics.Financial: Bank statements, account notices, general financial documents
topics.Health: Medical bills, health insurance EOBs, lab results, prescriptions
topics.Home: Mortgage, property tax, home repairs, HOA
topics.Employment: Pay stubs, offer letters, HR documents
topics.Utility: Electric, gas, water, phone, internet bills
topics.Dining: Restaurant receipts, food delivery, cafe charges
topics.Travel: Flights, hotels, rental cars, vacation bookings, transportation
topics.Shopping: Retail purchases, online orders, general merchandise receipts
topics.Other: Anything that does not fit the other categories, or too unclear to tell
